content:
Maya S.: Heads up — eu-west canary for billing-service v3.1.0 -> v3.2.0 showing memory pressure during prefix-cache warmup. Pods restart intermittently, not 5xx but p95 latency rising.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Canary rollout initiated: billing-service v3.1.0 -> v3.2.0 (canary 15%). Health: passing=89/100, restarts=4 in 12m, error budget on-watch. Canary TTL 00:35.
Diego L.: Logs: java OOM in worker threads during cache load. Chart diff shows `defaults.workers: 4 -> 10` in values. That seems likely.
Priya N.: Two quick options: A) pin chart to previous values/image (rollback/pin) or B) perform a targeted values hotfix for canary (reduce workers, raise replicas) and continue. Thoughts?
Diego L.: Prefer B — less blast radius if we can stabilize. We'll keep image the same.
SRE Oncall: If scheduling degrades we'll need to scale nodes; keep me in the loop.
Maya S.: Proposed runbook:
- Set canary fraction 8% (from 15)
- Override canary values: `defaults.workers=3`, `canary.replicaCount=4`
- Command: ```helm upgrade billing --reuse-values ./charts/billing -n services --set canary.percent=8 --set defaults.workers=3 --set canary.replicaCount=4```
- Observe `kubectl get pods -lapp=billing-canary -n services` and p95 traces for 15m.
- If restarts continue or p95 > 2s -> execute rollback to previous release: `helm rollback billing 5 --wait -n services` and open rollback thread.
Deploy Bot: Canary percent adjustment requires 2 approvals.
Priya N.: Ack. I'll monitor traces and slow queries.
Diego L.: Ack. I'll run the helm upgrade and post output.
Release Notes Bot: Reminder: add short note if we change values in-flight.
Diego L.: Running now...
Diego L.: ```
$ helm upgrade billing --reuse-values ./charts/billing -n services --set canary.percent=8 --set defaults.workers=3 --set canary.replicaCount=4
Release "billing" has been upgraded. Configured canary overrides applied.
```
Diego L.: `kubectl rollout status deploy/billing-canary -n services` -> rollout completed in 55s.
Priya N.: After 10m p95 dropped from 1.6s -> 0.9s, no restarts observed in 12m.
SRE Oncall: Node memory usage back to normal, no scheduling delays.
Maya S.: Good. Keep canary at 8% for 45m and then decide promote vs pin. If stable, we should pin chart in chartmuseum with a patch release (3.2.1-hotfix-values) so we don't accidentally reintroduce the high-worker default on future promotions.
Release Notes Bot: Draft note suggestion: "Canary mitigation: temporary values adjustment (workers reduced, replicaCount increased) to address memory pressure during cache warmup. No image change. Monitoring continues."
Priya N.: I'll add the RN blurb and assign QA verification.
Diego L.: Also adding a small test in CI to exercise cache warmup with lower worker concurrency to catch this in future.
Maya S.: Thanks everyone. If any regression appears we follow the rollback command above. Leaving thread open for the 45m verdict.
Priya N.: Will report back at 1704030399 with final canary status.
